content_units: Movie Night Fit Snapshot

Based on your priorities, the best fits are the titles that are   funny or adventurous  ,   not too scary  ,   under 125 minutes  ,   released after 2000  , and broadly enjoyable for   ages 12–45  . From your list, these 5 rank highest overall.
Ranked Streaming Picks
Rank   Film   Year   Rating   Runtime   Why it fits   Caution
1     Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse     2018   PG   117 min   Fast, funny, adventurous, visually exciting, and great for both kids and adults   Mild comic-book action
2     Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle     2017   PG-13   119 min   Big crowd-pleaser with comedy, adventure, and easy group-watch energy   Some innuendo and action violence
3     Enola Holmes     2020   PG-13   123 min   Light mystery-adventure, charming pace, and very accessible for mixed ages   Mild peril and fight scenes
4     Paddington 2     2017   PG   103 min   Warm, funny, very easygoing, and one of the safest all-ages picks   Less action than the top 3
5     Knives Out     2019   PG-13   130 min   Very fun and smart for a group, with humor and mystery   Slightly over your runtime target; murder theme
Why These Beat the Other Options
Option 1:   Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse     Best all-around match for humor, adventure, pace, and age range     Strongest overall fit
Option 2:   Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle     Best if you want the most laughs and a casual popcorn-movie vibe     Best comedy-forward pick
Option 3:   Enola Holmes     Best if your group wants lighter mystery with adventure and minimal intensity     Best low-stress pick
Option 4:   Paddington 2     Sweetest and safest choice, especially if you want something universally likable     Best comfort watch
Option 5:   Knives Out     Great group movie, but less ideal because it runs a bit long and has a murder setup     Best trade-off pick
Why the Others Ranked Lower
-   Coco  : Excellent film and age-friendly, but it’s more heartfelt/fantasy than funny-adventurous.
-   The Martian  : Strong adventure pick, but less comedic-group energy than the top choices.
-   Ocean’s Eleven  : Fun and stylish, but older than your preferred post-2000 release window.
-   Interstellar  : Too long at 169 minutes.
-   A Quiet Place  : Too scary/intense for your “not too scary” preference.
Quick Actions
Pick  1
Pick  2
Title-Matching Notes
I treated   “released after 2000”   as favoring 2001+ titles, which is why   Ocean’s Eleven (2001)   was eligible but still ranked below newer, better-fit options.
